messages:
maria.cheng: Heads-up: planned topology switchover in us-west2 tonight 02:00–03:00 PST. Well migrate racks 12–15 from legacy egress to the new router fabric. Affects GPU pools: saturn (primary) and halo (spill). Expect rolling reboots + egress cutover per rack.
jake: Ack. What's the plan for draining and backfill? any expected capacity hit numbers?
maria.cheng: Plan: rack-by-rack. For each rack: cordon -> graceful drain (kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data) -> reboot edge switch -> verify egress path -> uncordon. Target 10m drain window per rack, 5m cooldown post-switch.
oliver-ops: If we do 10m drain per rack x4 racks that's ~40m but overlap risk if drains stagger. Do we have headroom to avoid queued jobs hitting spot/long-run cost?
maria.cheng: Good call. Modeling suggests ~15–20% instantaneous GPU capacity reduction per rack during its drain. If backfill hits worst-case we project ~+$1.2k/hr in spot top-ups for the region (short term). We'll run stricter admission for non-prod queues during the window.
anika-pm: Can we nudge to 04:00 instead? APAC batch jobs finish by 03:30 local, would reduce impact to customers.
maria.cheng: Tight — we have partner data ingest at 04:30 UTC that depends on new egress policy being live in us-west2 by 06:00 UTC. Moving later breaks onboarding. Keeping 02:00–03:00 is the least-bad for global constraints.
leo-sre: I'll own the runbook during the window. Preflight checks I want run 60/20/5 mins before. Quick egress-verification snippet I will use:
```
# egress check
for r in rack12 rack13 rack14 rack15; do
  ssh ops@$r 'curl -sS http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id || echo FAIL'
done
```
Run it after switch to verify instance-level SNAT path.
jake: Who will throttle scheduled training jobs? I can add temporary policy to the scheduler (scale down non-critical queues to 30%).
maria.cheng: Please do, thanks. Also add a routing fallback: if new router reports >1% packet loss for 2m we fail back to legacy for that rack.
leo-sre: I'll add alert: egress-loss >1% sustained -> automatic rollback. Also will watch token latency dashboards and prefix-cache hit-rate.
oliver-ops: What about model cache warmup after switchover? cold KV cache could spike token cost. Suggest pre-warm for top 10 models for 30m.
maria.cheng: Agreed. Schedules: pre-warm job at T-30m hitting top-models with small prompts, then T-5m smoke.
sre-bot: Scheduled maintenance created: "us-west2 topology switchover (racks 12-15)" — 2026-03-21 02:00–03:00 PST. Calendar: https://cal.example.com/meet/abcd1234. Oncall: leo-sre.
anika-pm: Noted, I'll update partner comms and add a short postmortem template to the calendar item.
maria.cheng: Final checklist: 1) Jake throttles non-prod queues 30% by 01:40. 2) Leo runs 60/20/5 preflight + verification. 3) Oliver run pre-warm at 01:30. 4) SRE will monitor token cost and rollback if cost delta > $2k/hr sustained. 5) Post-run health check at +30m.
jake: Will do throttle + doc of rollback procedure.
leo-sre: Copy. I'll push small automation to run egress checks and post results to this thread during the window.
